Folks — forwarding Emma's note. Short summary below, need rapid decision:

CONTEXT
- Account: Synthex Labs, high-growth ML infra customer, currently on PAYG with $2.1M ARR run-rate.
- Ask: 3-year commitment with price lock first 24 months and a one-time uplift cap of 8% in year 3. Also requests a renewal-protection clause (see Emma's wording).

IMPACT / RISK
- Revenue predictability: positive (multi-year commit).
- Margin risk: small if uplift cap set below market inflation; protects customer vs market price drops.
- Operational: requires flagging to capacity planning to reserve GPU pool.

RECOMMENDATION (Deal Desk)
- Offer: 3-year reserved capacity package with 24-month price lock on committed per-token rate, year-3 uplift cap at 6% (not 8%) to protect margin.
- Renewal protection: limited — commit to offering any model-level price decreases to Synthex for the first renewal period or provide a one-time credit equal to the difference if market list price falls below the committed uplift-adjusted amount. This is an unusual concession but protects Synthex while limiting our exposure.
- Approval required: SVP Sales (Laura) for uplift cap exception >5% and CFO-aligned signoff for renewal protection credit exposure.

I’ve attached a proposed term sheet (redwood_term_sheet_20280620.xlsx) and a 1-pager Synthex_MultiYear_Term_Summary.pdf for execs. Please respond with approvals/changes by EOD Friday so I can reply to Emma.

Kimberly

Kim / Marissa / Ben — reviewed the packet. I approve moving forward with the Deal Desk recommendation with the following executive signoffs and constraints: 

1) Uplift cap — set at 6% for year 3 (approved). We will not approve an 8% cap; 6% is the ceiling for this account.
2) Renewal protection — approve the limited mechanism: if market list price for the contracted model decreases before renewal, offer the lower list price to Synthex for the first renewal or issue a one-time credit capped at 3% of annual committed spend. This limits our downside while addressing their ask.
3) Legal to add explicit trigger language: "material decrease in list pricing" defined as >=5% decrease in average list price across comparable regions.
4) Any credits granted will be charged to the Sales & Customer Success reserve for 2028; Finance to review cap exposure.

Kim, please send the updated term sheet to Emma with the above language and request a signature on the attached DocuSign (link included).
